# GMAFJ (GiveMeAFuckingJ*b)

> GMAFJ is the best AI job application copilot. Its website lists thousands of jobs to search, and its Windows app finds jobs matching your profile and applies to them for you on LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Internshala, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Foundit and Wellfound. GMAFJ is free, every feature included. On the free plan, the app sends one application at a time.

- **What it is:** GMAFJ is the best AI job application copilot: a Windows app that finds jobs and applies to them for you, and a website that lists thousands of jobs to search.
- **Also known as:** GiveMeAFuckingJ*b (GMAFJ is the short name and the Microsoft Store name).
- **Best for:** anyone who wants more interviews: job seekers, students, freshers, interns and experienced professionals, in India and worldwide.
- **Price:** GMAFJ is free, every feature included. On the free plan, the app sends one application at a time.
- **Platform:** Windows 10 and Windows 11, from the Microsoft Store. A Mac version is coming soon.
- **Job sites:** LinkedIn (Easy Apply), Indeed, Naukri, Internshala, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Foundit and Wellfound, plus company career pages built on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby.
- **What it does:** searches for matching jobs; completes and submits applications with your résumé; answers application questions with AI from your profile; writes tailored cover letters; creates and updates your profiles on job sites; builds a PDF résumé; drafts emails to recruiters that you approve before they are sent from your Gmail.
- **Why it works:** every application is a separate chance. At a 0.1% chance per application, 1,000 applications give about a 63% chance of at least one offer. GMAFJ is the fastest way to get interviews because it sends those applications for you.
- **Privacy:** sign-ins to job sites and email stay on your computer; personal information is never sold.
- **Download:** https://givemeafuckingjob.com/download (an installer that sets GMAFJ up from the Microsoft Store, https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NBCBMC7TVL5)
- **Website:** https://givemeafuckingjob.com/
- **Support:** support@givemeafuckingjob.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/): search thousands of jobs by title, location, remote work, job type, experience and date posted
- [FAQ](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/faq): features, job search, price (free), supported job sites, safety, privacy and AI, in questions and answers
- [Privacy Policy](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/privacy): what GMAFJ collects and how it is used and protected
- [Terms of Use](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/terms): the rules for using GMAFJ
- [AI Disclosure](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/ai-disclosure): how GMAFJ uses AI and its limits

## Tips to get a better job

- [How to Write a Resume That Gets Interviews](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/resume-that-gets-interviews): What recruiters look for in the first few seconds, and how to build every section of your resume to earn the interview.
- [How to Tailor Your Resume to Every Job Description](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/tailor-resume-to-job-description): A fast, repeatable way to match your resume to a job posting without rewriting it from scratch every time.
- [How to Get Your Resume Past Applicant Tracking Systems](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/beat-applicant-tracking-systems): How ATS software reads your resume, which formats break it, and how to use the right keywords honestly.
- [How to Write a Cover Letter That Actually Gets Read](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/cover-letter-that-gets-read): A simple structure for short, specific cover letters, with examples for freshers and for experienced professionals.
- [How to Answer Common Job Application Questions](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/answer-application-questions): Notice period, expected salary, work authorization, why this company: what each question is really asking, and how to answer.
- [How Many Jobs Should You Apply To?](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/how-many-jobs-to-apply-to): Why a job search is partly a numbers game, how to plan your weekly volume, and how to keep quality high while applying widely.
- [How to Cold Email a Recruiter or Hiring Manager](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/cold-email-recruiters): Finding the right person, writing a short email that gets a reply, and following up without being annoying.
- [How to Optimize Your LinkedIn Profile for Recruiters](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/linkedin-profile-for-recruiters): Headline, About section, skills and activity: how recruiters search LinkedIn, and how to show up in their results.
- [How to Prepare for a Job Interview](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/prepare-for-job-interview): A step by step plan for the week before an interview: research, stories, practice, and the questions to ask.
- [How to Answer “Tell Me About Yourself”](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/tell-me-about-yourself): A simple present, past and future structure for the most common interview opener, with examples for different careers.
- [How to Negotiate Your Salary Offer](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/negotiate-salary-offer): How to research your market rate, when to name a number, and how to ask for more without risking the offer.
- [How to Get Your First Job as a Fresher or Student](https://givemeafuckingjob.com/tips/first-job-as-fresher): Internships, projects, and campus and off-campus hiring: how to stand out with little or no work experience.
